svg.title: The build review loop with the model at every seat
svg.desc: Clay works back and forth with Claude.ai on strategy, then sends the approved decision to Zippy, an autonomous agent running Sonnet 5. Zippy starts his loop script, which runs no model. The builder runs Claude Opus 5 on the Max plan. An objective gate of raw shell commands compiles tests and boots the code and returns failures straight to the builder. The reviewer runs Claude Fable 5 on the Max plan, read only, and returns failures to the builder. A model audit records the model that actually answered at each seat. The script returns the result to Zippy, who verifies independently and reports to Clay, who reviews with Claude.ai.
svg.text: Cap of five iterations. A missing model or an exhausted quota aborts with its own exit code instead of
looking like a normal review failure, so no iteration is spent feeding an error back to the builder as a fix prompt.
